image_description: A side-front view of a compact, boxy minibus parked on a paved street. The vehicle features a two-tone color scheme (beige/cream lower body and dark brown/black upper front) with red accents. It has a large windshield, a row of side passenger windows, and visible wheels. The background shows urban buildings and a spire.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof, short-wheelbase proportions of a minibus, distinct from full-size transit buses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is clearly visible, along with multiple rectangular side windows indicating a passenger cabin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle height is consistent with standing headroom, and the door placement is visible near the front wheel arch.
Vertical seams and panel lines near the front wheel indicate the presence of a sliding or folding door mechanism typical of this class.
The short hood ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout, consistent with van-based minibuses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is occluded by the viewing angle; only the side and front are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bus displays a specific multi-color livery (beige/brown/red) which fits the 'company livery' description, though not strictly white/yellow.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wheels are proportionate to a heavy-duty van chassis, appearing structurally sound with visible rims.
The window count and overall length suggest a capacity within the 4-10 passenger range.

artifact_observations.location: Front destination sign and side branding
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the digital destination board above the windshield and the branding on the side panels is illegible and distorted, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than clear characters.

artifact_observations.location: Lower body panels and wheel wells
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight smudging and lack of sharp definition in the panel gaps and around the wheel arches, giving a slightly 'painted' or soft appearance compared to real-world mechanical precision.
The geometry of the front bumper and headlight assembly is slightly irregular and asymmetrical, with soft edges that do not align perfectly with the rigid body lines.

alignment_reasoning: The image strongly conforms to the 'minibus' class. All testable geometric and functional checkpoints are present, including the correct silhouette, window arrangement, and wheel proportions. The only non-testable checkpoint was the rear view due to occlusion. The visual identity is unmistakably that of a compact passenger bus.
artifact_reasoning: While the overall structure is coherent, there are noticeable AI artifacts. The most prominent issue is gibberish text on the signage and side decals. Additionally, there is minor structural softness in the front bumper geometry and slight texture smearing on the lower body panels, preventing a perfect artifact-free score.
